SELECT TOP(1) (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM [Chapter] AS [c]
    WHERE ([c].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [c].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [c].[DeleteDate] IS NULL AND [m].[Id] = [c].[MangaId]) AS [TotalChapters], CASE
    WHEN [t].[Id] IS NULL THEN CAST(0 AS bigint)
    ELSE [t].[TotalCount]
END AS [TotalViews], (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(CAST([r].[Rating] AS int) AS float))
    FROM [Rating] AS [r]
    WHERE ([r].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [r].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [r].[DeleteDate] IS NULL AND [m].[Id] = [r].[ToMangaId]) AS [AverageRating], (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM [Follow] AS [f]
    WHERE ([f].[IdUserDelete] IS NULL OR [f].[IdUserDelete] LIKE N'') AND [f].[DeleteDate] IS NULL AND [m].[Id] = [f].[MangaId]) AS [TotalFollows]
FROM [Manga] AS [m]
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT [v].[Id], [v].[MangaId], [v].[TotalCount]
    FROM [ViewCount] AS [v]
